purpose: Resolve the 25 °C methanol comparison without inventing a 25 °C methanol point value

governmentSources.title: 消防研究所報告 第129号 表1 アルコールの性質
governmentSources.fact: The methanol column lists 200 mmHg at 34.8 °C and 100 mmHg at 21.2 °C.

governmentSources.title: 環境省 化学物質の環境リスク評価 酢酸メチル
governmentSources.fact: Methyl acetate has measured vapor pressure 216 mmHg at 25 °C.

inference: For methanol, 25 °C lies below 34.8 °C, where vapor pressure is 200 mmHg; saturation vapor pressure rises with temperature, so methanol at 25 °C is below 200 mmHg. Methyl acetate is 216 mmHg at 25 °C and therefore exceeds methanol at the exam's temperature.
limitations: This proves the comparison, not an exact methanol vapor pressure at 25 °C. It does not itself approve all five choice explanations or change any public overlay.
acceptance: source research only; independent direct review and candidate correction pending
